reviews.title: Inconsistency
reviews.text:
The distance tracking is extremely inconsistent and makes the app difficult to trust. I can walk the exact same route on the same trail and get significantly different mileage readings.

For example, today I walked one direction on the trail and the app recorded 0.93 miles. I ended the session, started a new one, and walked the same exact trail back in the opposite direction. This time it recorded 1.19 miles.

That’s a 0.26-mile difference on what should be the same distance, which is significant for a walk of only about a mile. This also throws off the pace and calorie metrics because they’re being calculated from an inaccurate distance.

This isn’t the first time I’ve noticed it either. I can walk the same route on different days and consistently get different distance readings.

I really want to like this app, but accurate GPS distance tracking is one of the most basic and important functions of a walking app. If I can’t trust the mileage, I can’t trust the rest of the workout data either. Please improve the GPS tracking and distance calculations.

reviews.text:
Awesome app, love it! ❤️👍

I didn’t like the announcement voices and the developer informed me that the voices are provided by Apple.  You can add additional voices via the iPhone Accessibility/Read & Speak/Voices.  Once you download additional voices they will automatically be made available in the Walkmeter app.  

Thank you developer for replying directly to me regarding the voices, and thank you for creating a fantastic app! 😁

reviews.title: Great for tracking distance, time, and route

Doesn’t count steps, but that’s not what I wanted it for. I love getting to see the distance, time, and calories updating along the way rather than just being given as a total at the end of the walk. While hiking, the map is especially helpful for knowing which trail to take next based on the line showing where you have already been.

Hiking and walking aren’t really competitive activities, but this app makes it so they can be in terms of stats and individual performance. 🧐
